title: Torsion-input detection with finite shifted output Hom groups
statement: Let l be a prime, E a finite extension of Q_l, and k a field in which l is invertible. Let X and Y be finite-type quasi-compact k-schemes, let f : X -> Y be a separated finite-type quasi-compact k-morphism, and let c be a compactification of f. Let F be the actual completed-coefficient proper/open compact-support functor on integral constructible inputs and G the recorded finite-system integral compact-support functor. Suppose that for every integral constructible input K and n >= 0, Hom(F(K)[1], Res_n Red_n G(K)) is finite. If two natural transformations F -> G agree on every integral constructible object in the essential image of some finite scalar-restriction functor Res_n, they are equal. No separatedness of the structure morphisms is assumed.
